house.description: Nursing Home Workforce Standards Board rule establishing nursing home minimum wage standards affecting medical assistance reimbursement rates made effective.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy
See 2025 1st Special Session HF3, Chapter 9, Article 1., Sections 1-3.

latest_action.text: See 2025 1st Special Session HF3, Chapter 9, Article 1., Sections 1-3.

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; making effective a Nursing Home Workforce Standards Board rule establishing nursing home minimum wage standards affecting medical assistance reimbursement rates.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+RULE EFFECTIVE. +]

[+Notwithstanding chapter 14, section 181.213, subdivision 2, paragraph (c), or any other law or rule to the contrary, Minnesota Rules, parts 5200.2060 to 5200.2090, as published on October 28, 2024, State Register, volume 49, number 18, page 443, establishing nursing home minimum wage standards affecting medical assistance reimbursement rates are effective January 1, 2026, or upon federal approval, whichever is later. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; making effective a Nursing Home Workforce Standards Board rule establishing nursing home minimum wage standards affecting medical assistance reimbursement rates.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. RULE EFFECTIVE.

Notwithstanding chapter 14, section 181.213, subdivision 2, paragraph (c), or any other law or rule to the contrary, Minnesota Rules, parts 5200.2060 to 5200.2090, as published on October 28, 2024, State Register, volume 49, number 18, page 443, establishing nursing home minimum wage standards affecting medical assistance reimbursement rates are effective January 1, 2026, or upon federal approval, whichever is later.
